decisions.reason: The lettering-reference change concerns caption font design and does not alter the separate clean-editing or prohibited-effects rules.
Matching the reference lettering does not explicitly change the existing white-text-only and no-text-effects requirements.
The message's B-roll clause is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY requiring B-roll in each full lesson.
The message reports a clip ending before its lesson was complete, which is already represented as same-message runtime evidence and does not change the existing completeness standard.
The reference videos are supplied for lettering and revision guidance, not as a change to which source videos may be selected for clips.
Requiring a full lesson does not change the existing rule to select substantive moments containing a lesson, story, or real point.
The source gives revision guidance but does not change the assigned batch count or batch-delivery obligation.
The message does not discuss or modify hook selection or clip-opening quality.
The lettering, B-roll, and lesson-completeness instructions do not alter background-music selection or volume.
The source does not change the monthly approved-clip target, approval authority, counting basis, or rejected-clip treatment.
The 45-second clip is identified as a concrete failure against the existing 70-to-85-second rule, already represented by a same-message runtime event; no duration value changes.
The revision instructions do not change the requirement for client approval before publication.
